summary: Copart filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive merger agreement under which it will acquire ACV Auctions for $10.50 per share in cash via a tender offer launched within 5-7 business days and held open a minimum of 10 business days, followed by a Section 251(h) back-end merger without a separate stockholder vote. The minimum condition requires majority tender plus HSR clearance and no injunction; the deal has no financing condition. Board recommendation and advisor fees are not detailed in the excerpt. Watch tendering levels, HSR timing, and any competing bid for a potential bump.
